thread:
Tim Carter: Exported CSV for 2026-11-01..2026-11-30 has rows that get misaligned when a prompt contains embedded quotes and newlines. Columns shift after the broken row.
Tim Carter: Steps to reproduce: Console > Analytics > Exports -> pick date range -> Export CSV -> download and open in Excel or pipe through csvkit.
Tim Carter: Example presigned URL: https://s3.redwood-internal/exports/0f3a9c2b.csv.gz
Tim Carter: Tiny excerpt from the downloaded CSV (I gunzipped then opened in a text editor):
```
export_id,created_at,prompt,completion
0f3a9c2b,2026-11-30T17:02:01Z,"User: Tell me about ""the best"" tools
for infra","OK: here's a list"
0f3a9c2b,2026-11-30T17:02:02Z,"Another prompt","Answer"
```
Tim Carter: The quote sequence + newline in the prompt breaks the row. CSV parser treats the newline as a row break.
Alex (Support): Sorry for the trouble — thanks for the clear repro. Does JSON export avoid the issue for you?
Tim Carter: JSON export is fine, but our ETL relies on CSV. Can you prioritize?
Alex (Support): Looping in eng: @Maria (Eng) @Jordan (Analytics PM) — assigning P2 for now.
Maria (Eng): Looking. Can you paste the exact commands you used to download? Sometimes gunzip flags differ across clients.
Tim Carter: I did:
```
curl -L -o export.csv.gz "https://s3.redwood-internal/exports/0f3a9c2b.csv.gz"
gunzip -c export.csv.gz > export.csv
head -n 6 export.csv
```
Maria (Eng): Repro'd locally with your file. Observed that exporter streams gzip chunks while writing CSV; if a quoted field spans a chunk boundary (quote + newline), the writer didn't escape internal quotes consistently, so downstream parsers misinterpret chunk-split sequences as end-of-field.
Maria (Eng): Short-term: we can re-run the job with a safeguard flag that forces doubling internal quotes before chunking. Internal admin rerun supports `?escape_quotes=on`. Alex, can you trigger a rerun for acme-inc export id 0f3a9c2b?
Alex (Support): Rerun started via Admin -> Exports -> Re-run (escape_quotes=on).
export-bot: export-service: re-run job 0f3a9c2b-rerun initiated (escape_quotes=on)
export-bot: export-service: job 0f3a9c2b-rerun completed, presigned URL: https://s3.redwood-internal/exports/0f3a9c2b-rerun.csv.gz
Tim Carter: Downloaded rerun and unzipped — prompts with quotes/newlines are intact, no column shifting.
Maria (Eng): Root cause: streaming writer did not guarantee quote-escaping semantics across gzip chunk boundaries. Fix plan: always pre-escape internal quotes (replace "\"" with "\"\"") before chunking OR buffer until quote closed. Opting for the first as it's simpler and avoids buffering.
Maria (Eng): Patch PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/export-service/pull/10112. Will add unit tests that inject multi-chunk quoted fields and run canary deploy (10%) first.
Jordan (Analytics PM): Impact: CSV-based ingestion jobs undercounted sessions for affected exports. We'll compile orgs that used CSV in the last 7 days and request reruns/backfill.
Alex (Support): I'll reach out to impacted customers with the rerun and JSON workaround while patch rolls out. Marking this thread P2 -> Follow-up.
Maria (Eng): Canary still healthy after 3h, no malformed CSVs observed. Full rollout scheduled in 24h barring regressions. Added regression test and will include release note about `escape_quotes` change.
Tim Carter: Thanks — confirmed fix on our side after rerun. Appreciate the quick response.
Alex (Support): Closing loop with acme contact and noting remediation. If any legal escalation occurs, escalate to me.
Maria (Eng): Post-deploy: we'll also scan recent exports for gzip chunk boundaries that could have caused corruption and proactively rerun any suspect jobs.
Tim Carter: Thanks again :thumbsup:
